scope: Guarded hosted lane A attempt at member account-popover cases T20, T23 and T26 on frozen unpublished development v0.2.502. The run reached real member sign-in and a native menu click but has no product acceptance credit.
native_observation: A real ordinary-member session was established: access token and profile present, isAdmin=false. The opened account menu contained one Profile, one Preferences and one Sign out action. After clicking Profile, the driver timed out with profile_selected_not_observed and serialized selected-tab count 0. T23 and T26 did not run.
driver_diagnosis: The failed oracle searched for a Profile tab-strip trigger. src/features/profile/ProfileView.tsx explicitly says Profile is not advertised in the tab strip; src/entrypoints/sidepanel/App.tsx renders Profile as a TabsContent destination without a Profile TabsTrigger. The failed assertion therefore cannot distinguish a successful Profile navigation from a product failure. A new active-tabpanel oracle is under source review.

product_verdict.reason: Resource final invalid, and the Profile destination assertion was unsound.

fixture_cleanup: The single-use link was generated from the existing verified reviewer identity, staged as a temporary GitHub secret through stdin, then the local file was removed. Immediately after terminal run, MATRX_REVIEWER_MAGIC_LINK_JSON was deleted and a secret-name lookup verified its absence; the local link file was also verified absent. No link, email, token or profile identifier is stored here.
next: After independent source review and green exact-source CI artifact, rerun the member case with a newly minted single-use link and preserve the resource-invalid boundary if it repeats. Admin remains serialized and independently fixture-gated.
